title: 共识策略不足：推理轨迹分歧作为知识表示信号
summary: 本文指出多智能体系统中通过投票、共识等减少分歧的策略在价值判断任务中不足，分歧可能反映规范不确定性而非错误。提出基于推理轨迹与决策抽象为符号化分歧状态的知识表示层，区分四种状态（趋同一致、趋异一致、趋同分歧、趋异分歧），支持可废止策略路由，并在内容审核中实例化，连接亚符号LLM推理与符号知识表示。
summary_en: This paper argues that consensus-seeking strategies in multi-agent systems are insufficient for value-laden tasks, as disagreement may reflect normative uncertainty. It proposes a knowledge-representation layer abstracting reasoning traces and decisions into symbolic disagreement states (convergent/divergent agreement/disagreement), supporting defeasible routing, instantiated in content moderation to bridge sub-symbolic LLM deliberation and symbolic knowledge representation.
